40011313.author: पदार्थः
40011313.content: शतयोजनम् hundred yojanas, क्रमितुम् to cross, जृम्भमाणम् enlarging, सहसा at once, वीर्येण in strength, आपूर्यमाणं च and being filled, वानरोत्तमम् best of monkeys, महाबलम् a warrior of great strength, तं हनूमन्तम् he, Hanuman, दृष्ट्वा seeing, ते those monkeys, सहसा all at once, शोकम् grief, उत्सृज्य gave up, प्रहर्षेण with joy, समन्विताः endowed, विनेदुः screamed aloud, तुष्टुवुश्चापि also propitiated him.

40011313.author: Translation
40011313.content: 'In order to cross a hundred yojanas, Hanuman, the best of monkeys expanded his  might and strength. Seeing him, a warrior of great strength, all the monkeys, filled with enthusiasm at once gave up grief and collected together.They rejoiced and propitiated him screaming aloud.

40011314.author: पदार्थः
40011314.content: शतयोजनम् hundred yojanas, क्रमितुम् to cross, जृम्भमाणम् enlarging, सहसा at once, वीर्येण in strength, आपूर्यमाणं च and being filled, वानरोत्तमम् best of monkeys, महाबलम् a warrior of great strength, तं हनूमन्तम् he, Hanuman, दृष्ट्वा seeing, ते those monkeys, सहसा all at once, शोकम् grief, उत्सृज्य gave up, प्रहर्षेण with joy, समन्विताः endowed, विनेदुः screamed aloud, तुष्टुवुश्चापि also propitiated him.

40011314.author: Translation
40011314.content: 'In order to cross a hundred yojanas, Hanuman, the best of monkeys expanded his  might and strength. Seeing him, a warrior of great strength, all the monkeys, filled with enthusiasm at once gave up grief and collected together.They rejoiced and propitiated him screaming aloud.

40011314.author: सारांशः
40011314.content: Hanuman displays his immeasurable might and proceeds to mount Mahendra

40011315.author: पदार्थः
40011315.content: समन्ततः collected together, प्रहृष्टाः happily, विस्मिताश्चैव wonderstruck, प्रजाः people,  त्रिविक्रमकृतोत्साहम् Lord Visnu's enthusiasm in taking three strides, नारायणमिव like Lord Narayana, वीक्षन्ते स्म they observed.

40011315.author: Translation
40011315.content: The monkeys collected together happily, gazing at Hanuman.They were wonderstruck to see Hanuman in that huge form, just as all beings were when they saw Lord Narayana in his incarnation of Vamana.

40011316.author: पदार्थः
40011316.content: महाबलः mighty, हनुमान् Hanuman, संस्तूयमानः being praised, हर्षात् joyfully, बलम् strength, उपेयिवान् assumed, लाङ्गूलम् tail, समाविध्य whirling, व्यवर्धत grew.

40011316.author: Translation
40011316.content: The monkeys praised the mighty Hanuman as he grew in size whirling his tail around joyfully.

40011317.author: पदार्थः
40011317.content: सर्वैः by all, वानरपुङ्गवैः by monkey leaders, संस्तूयमानस्य of him being praised, तेजसा with lustre, पूर्यमाणस्य who was filled, तस्य his, रूपम् body, अनुत्तमम् excellent, आसीत् became.

40011317.author: Translation
40011317.content: As Hanuman was being praised by the monkey leaders, his body filled with lustre. It looked excellent.

40011318.author: पदार्थः
40011318.content: विवृद्धः grown, गिरिगह्वरे in a mountain cave, सिंहः lion, यथा as, विजृम्भते he stretches himself, मारुतस्य Windgod's, औरसः पुत्रः lawful son, सम्प्रति at that time, तथा like that, जृम्भते grew.

40011318.author: Translation
40011318.content: Just as a lion grown in a mountain cave stretches its body, the Windgod's son stretched  (his limbs) at that time.

40011319.author: पदार्थः
40011319.content: जृम्भमाणस्य on expansion, धीमतः of the wise person, तस्य his, मुखम् face, आदीप्तम्  glowing, अम्बरीषमिव like a burning oven, विधूमः smokeless, पावकः इव firelike, अशोभत was shining.

40011319.author: Translation
40011319.content: On expansion, wise Hanuman's face was bright, glowing like a burning oven and  shining like smokeless fire.

40011320.author: पदार्थः
40011320.content: हरीणाम् from the monkeys, मध्यात् from the midst, उत्थितः he rose, सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः with the hair bristling on the body, हनुमान् Hanuman, वृद्धान् elderly, हरीन् monkeys (Jambavan), अभिवाद्य saluted reverentially, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् said.

40011320.author: Translation
40011320.content: Hanuman risen from the midst of the monkeys with his hair bristling on the body (due to expansion of body), saluted reverentially to the elderly monkey Jambavan and said :

40011321.author: पदार्थः
40011321.content: हुताशनसखः friend of fire, हुताशन the consumer of oblations, बलवान् powerful one, अप्रमेयः च and immesurable, आकाशगोचरः one who wanders in the sky, अनिलः fire, वायुः wind, सर्वताग्राणि mountain tops, अरुजत् shattered.

40011321.author: Translation
40011321.content: 'The Windgod is a friend of fire who is a powerful consumer of oblations. His strength is immeasurable. He wanders in the sky and shatters the mountain tops.

40011322.author: पदार्थः
40011322.content: शीघ्रवेगस्य swiftmoving god's, शीघ्रगस्य of a swift one, महात्मनः of a great one, तस्य his, मारुतस्य Windgod's, औरसः पुत्रः lawfulson, अहम् I am, प्लवनेन in leaping, तत्समः equal to him, अस्मि I am.

40011322.author: Translation
40011322.content: 'I am the lawfulson of the swiftmoving Windgod, Maruta, comparable to him in leaping.

40011323.author: पदार्थः
40011323.content: विस्तीर्णम् vast, expansive, अम्बरम् sky, अलिखन्तमिव as if rubbing , मेरुं गिरिम् Meru mount, असंगेन without touching, सहस्रशः thousand times, परिगन्तुम् can go round, उत्सहेयं हि I wish with all enthusiasm.

40011323.author: Translation
40011323.content: 'I can with all enthusiasm go round the vast mount Meru a thousand times without resting on it which is as though scratching the sky.

40011324.author: पदार्थः
40011324.content: अहम् I, बाहुवेगप्रणुन्नेन can drive away with my arms with high speed, सागरेण the ocean, सपर्वतनदीह्रदम् with mountains, rivers and lakes, लोकम् world, प्लावयितुम् to submerge, उत्सहे eager.

40011324.author: Translation
40011324.content: 'I can submerge this world including its mountains rivers and lakes. I can push back the sea waters quickly with my arms.

40011325.author: पदार्थः
40011325.content: वरुणालयः  abode of Varuna,ocean समुद्रः ocean, मम my, ऊरुजङ्घावेगेन with the thrust of my thighs and calf muscles, समुत्थितः will rise up, सम्मूर्च्छितमहाग्राहः the mighty sea crocodiles stunned by the force, भविष्यति it will be.

40011325.author: Translation
40011325.content: 'Thrust by my thighs,the ocean will rise up, carrying with it the shanks and  mighty crocodiles stunned by the force.

40011326.author: पदार्थः
40011326.content: पन्नगाशनम् a consumer of snakes, the Garuda, पक्षिसेविते occupied by birds, आकाशे in the sky, पतन्तम् flying, वैनतेयम् to son of Vinata (Garuda), सहस्रशः a thousand times, परिगन्तुम् to go round, अहम् I, शक्तः able.

40011326.author: Translation
40011326.content: 'I am capable of circumambulating a thousand times the great Garuda who consumes snakes and flies in the sky, the abode of birds.

40011327.author: पदार्थः
40011327.content: प्लवगर्षभाः O bull among monkeys, उदयात् from the mountain behind which the sun rises, प्रस्थितम् starts, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, रश्मिमालिनम् with rays, आदित्यम् the Sun, अनस्तमितम् before he sets, अभिगन्तुम् to approach, अहम् I, उत्सहे rise, ततः then, भूमिम् earth, अस्पृष्ट्वा without touching, भीमेन with a terrific, महता with great, प्रवेगेनैव with the same high speed, पुनः again, आगन्तुम् to return, उत्सहे I desire.

40011327.author: Translation
40011327.content: 'O bull among monkeys when the Sun rises from behind the eastern mountain it is possible for me to start with him and go to the western horizon and return before the blazing Sun with its beams of light sets. It is also possible for me to descend to  the earth with the same speed and return to the Sun without touching the earth.

40011328.author: पदार्थः
40011328.content: प्लवगर्षभाः O bull among monkeys, उदयात् from the mountain behind which the sun rises, प्रस्थितम् starts, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, रश्मिमालिनम् with rays, आदित्यम् the Sun, अनस्तमितम् before he sets, अभिगन्तुम् to approach, अहम् I, उत्सहे rise, ततः then, भूमिम् earth, अस्पृष्ट्वा without touching, भीमेन with a terrific, महता with great, प्रवेगेनैव with the same high speed, पुनः again, आगन्तुम् to return, उत्सहे I desire.

40011328.author: Translation
40011328.content: 'O bull among monkeys when the Sun rises from behind the eastern mountain it is possible for me to start with him and go to the western horizon and return before the blazing Sun with its beams of light sets. It is also possible for me to descend to  the earth with the same speed and return to the Sun without touching the earth.

40011329.author: पदार्थः
40011329.content: आकाशगोचरान् those that fly in the sky, सर्वान् all, अतिक्रान्तुम् to overtake, उत्सहेयम् easily, सागरं ocean, क्षोभयिष्यामि I will stir up, मेदिनीम् earth, दारयिष्यामि I will tear up.

40011329.author: Translation
40011329.content: 'If I rise up, I can overtake all those creatures flying in the sky and from there I can stir up the ocean and tear up the earth easily.

40011330.author: पदार्थः
40011330.content: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, प्लवमानः while I leap, पर्वतान् mountains, चूर्णयिष्यामि can crush them to powder, प्लवमानः when I leap, ऊरुवेगेन with the force of my thighs, महार्णवम् vast ocean, हरिष्यामि can pull with me.

40011330.author: Translation
40011330.content: 'O monkeys when I leap, I can crush the mountains into powder and pull the vast ocean with me with the force of my thighs.

40011331.author: पदार्थः
40011331.content: अद्य now, विहायसा through the sky, प्लवमानम् as I leap, माम् me, लतानाम् of creepers, पादपानां च and of trees, विविधम् many, पुष्पम् flower, सर्वशः all over, अनुयास्यन्ति will follow me.

40011331.author: Translation
40011331.content: And then as I leap through the sky flowers of many kinds of creepers and trees will follow me.

40011332.author: पदार्थः
40011332.content: वानराः monkeys अम्बरे in the sky, मे I, पन्थाः path, स्वातेः of the constellation of Swati, पन्थाः इव like the path, भविष्यति will be, घोरम् terrific, आकाशम् sky, उत्पतिष्यन्तमेव च as I am flying upward, चरन्तम् while I am moving, निपतिष्यन्तम् while I am descending, सर्वभूतानि all creatures, द्रक्ष्यन्ति will see me.

40011332.author: Translation
40011332.content: 'O monkey when I fly upward in the dreadful sky or descend down, all creatures will see me, for my path will be the path of the constellation of Swati (a group of stars).

40011333.author: पदार्थः
40011333.content: वानरा: O monkeys, महामेरुप्रतीकाशम् like the great mount Meru, दिवम् sky, आवृत्य after enveloping, गच्छन्तम् while I go, अम्बरम् the sky, ग्रसमानम् इव like the one swallowing the sky, माम् me, द्रक्ष्यथ you will see.

40011333.author: Translation
40011333.content: 'O monkeys when I fly in the sky like the great mount Meru, you will see me as if I am swallowing the sky because I will be enveloping it with my strides.

40011334.author: पदार्थः
40011334.content: समाहितः a composed self, प्लवमानः while I am leaping, जीमतान् clouds, विधमिष्यामि I scatter them up,पर्वतान् all mountains, कम्पयिष्यामि I will shake up, सागरम् ocean, शोषयिष्यामि I will agitate

40011334.author: Translation
40011334.content: Leaping in concentration, I shall scatter the clouds, shake the mountains, and dry up the ocean.

40011335.author: पदार्थः
40011335.content: वैनतेयस्य Garuda's, मारुतस्य वा Maruta's, या such, शक्तिः capacity, सा that, मम my, प्लुतम् flying, माम् me, यत् such, भूतम् a creature, अनुव्रजेत् that can follow, तत् that, सुपर्णराजानम् king of vultures, महाजवम् speedy, मारुतं वा ऋते or excepting the wind, न प्रपश्यामि I do not see.

40011335.author: Translation
40011335.content: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.

40011336.author: पदार्थः
40011336.content: वैनतेयस्य Garuda's, मारुतस्य वा Maruta's, या such, शक्तिः capacity, सा that, मम my, प्लुतम् flying, माम् me, यत् such, भूतम् a creature, अनुव्रजेत् that can follow, तत् that, सुपर्णराजानम् king of vultures, महाजवम् speedy, मारुतं वा ऋते or excepting the wind, न प्रपश्यामि I do not see.

40011336.author: Translation
40011336.content: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.

40011337.author: पदार्थः
40011337.content: घनात् from the, उत्थिता generated, विद्युदिव like the lightning, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in less than a  moment, सहसा at once, निरालम्बनम् that which has no support, अम्बरम् sky, निपतिष्यामि I will land.

40011337.author: Translation
40011337.content: 'Just as the lightning generated by the clouds lands at once flying in the sky without any support I can also land in less than a moment.

40011338.author: पदार्थः
40011338.content: सागरे in the ocean, प्लवमानस्य while I am leaping over, मे my, रूपम् form, पुरा earlier, त्रीन् three, विक्रमान् strides, प्रक्रममाणस्य who advanced, विष्णोः इव like Visnu, भविष्यति will be

40011338.author: Translation
40011338.content: As I leap over the ocean, my form will be like that of Vishnu of old measuring out his three strides.

40011339.author: पदार्थः
40011339.content: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, अहम् I, बुद्ध्या with my intellect, प्रपश्यामि I can visualise, मे my, मनश्चेष्टा च my feeling in mind, तथा so also, अहम् I am, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, द्रक्ष्यामि I will see, प्रमोदध्वम् be happy.

40011339.author: Translation
40011339.content: 'O monkeys I have a feeling in my mind that I will see Vaidehi. Be happy.

40011340.author: पदार्थः
40011340.content: वेगे in speed, मारुतस्य Maruta's, समः equal, जवे in rapidity, गरुडस्य Garuda's, समः equal, योजनानाम् of yojanas, अयुतम् ten thousand, गमिष्यामीति I will go, मे my, मतिः feeling.

40011340.author: Translation
40011340.content: 'I am equal to Maruta and Garuda in speed. I feel I can cover ten thousand yojanas (at a stretch).

40011341.author: पदार्थः
40011341.content: विक्रम्य after advancing, सवज्रस्य of that Indra the wielder of thunderbolt, वासवस्य Vasava's, स्वयम्भुवः of the self born, ब्रह्मणो वा of the ceator Brahma even, हस्तात् from his hand, सहसा at once, अमृतम् nectar, इह here, आनये I will get, लङ्काम् Lanka, समुत्क्षिप्य वापि uprooting, गच्छेयम् I can go, इति this way, मे my, मतिः feel in mind.

40011341.author: Translation
40011341.content: 'I think I can encounter Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt and obtain nectar from his hands. I can even confront Brahma, the selfborn creator courageously. I can even uproot Lanka and carry it.'

40011342.author: पदार्थः
40011342.content: तत्र there, एवम् in that way, गर्जन्तम् roaring aloud, अमितौजसम् shining brilliantly, तम् him, वानरश्रेष्ठम् best of monkeys, हरयः monkeys, प्रहृष्टाः joyful, विस्मिताः amazed, समुदैक्षन्त all looked at him.

40011342.author: Translation
40011342.content: The monkeys looked at him and were amazed, happy to see him roaring and shining in brilliance.

40011343.author: पदार्थः
40011343.content: तस्य his, तत् that, ज्ञातीनाम् of the kith and kin, शोकनाशनम् remover of  grief, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, हरिसत्तम: finest of monkeys, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, परिसम्हृष्टः very glad, उवाच said.

40011343.author: Translation
40011343.content: Jambavan, the finest of the monkeys, felt very glad on hearing his words which put an end to the sorrow of the kith and kin and said:

40011344.author: पदार्थः
40011344.content: वीर O hero, केसरिणः Kesari's, पुत्र son, मारुतात्मज O son of Marutha, तात O dear, त्वया by you, ज्ञातीनाम् of the kith and kin, विपुलः profound, शोकः grief, प्रणाशितः has been removed.

40011344.author: Translation
40011344.content: 'O son of Kesari O son of Maruta O hero you have removed the great grief of your race, dear

40011345.author: पदार्थः
40011345.content: तव your, कल्याणरुचयः well wishers, समागताः collected, कपिमुख्याः chiefs of monkeys, समाहिताः collected together, कार्य(अर्थ)सिद्ध्यर्थम् to achieve your objective, मङ्गलां auspicious prayers, करिष्यन्ति they will offer.

40011345.author: Translation
40011345.content: Your well-wishers, the monkey chiefs, have gathered and will with one mind offer auspicious prayers for the success of your mission.

40011346.author: पदार्थः
40011346.content: ऋषीणाम् of sages, प्रसादेन by the grace, कपिवृद्धमतेन च elderly monkeys', गुरूणाम् of elderlies, प्रसादेन by grace, च and, त्वम् you, महार्णवम् vast ocean, प्लवस्य cross.

40011346.author: Translation
40011346.content: 'By the blessings of the sages and by the grace of the elderly monkeys may you cross over the vast ocean.

40011347.author: पदार्थः
40011347.content: तव your, आगमनं यावत् awaiting your arrival, एकपादेन on one foot, स्थास्यामः we will stand, सर्वेषाम् of all of us, वनौकसाम् of forestdwellers, जीवनानि lives, त्वद्गतानि will depend upon you.

40011347.author: Translation
40011347.content: We will stand poised on one foot awaiting your return, for the lives of all us forest-dwellers depend upon you.

40011348.author: पदार्थः
40011348.content: ततः then, हरिशार्दूलः tiger among monkeys, तान् to those, वनौकसः monkeys, उवाच said, इयं this, मही earth, मम my, वेगम् speed, लङ्घने while crossing, न धारयिष्यति it cannot sustain.

40011348.author: Translation
40011348.content: Then the tiger among monkeys, Hanuman said to those forestdwellers (monkeys), 'The earth cannot bear the thrust of my leaping.

40011349.author: पदार्थः
40011349.content: शिलासङ्कटशालिनः the rocks of the mountain ranges, अस्य of this, महेन्द्रस्य नगरस्य Mahendra mountain's, एतानि these, शिखराणि peaks, स्थिराणि stable, सुमहान्ति च are very  huge.

40011349.author: Translation
40011349.content: 'The rocks on the peaks of the ranges of mount Mahendra cannot with stand it, although they are huge and firm.

40011350.author: पदार्थः
40011350.content: नानाद्रुमविकीर्णेषु  scattered with different kinds of trees, धातुनिष्यन्दशोभिषु shining with different kinds of minerals, एष: here I am, महेन्द्रशिखरेषु peaks of mountain Mahendra, अहम् I, वेगम् speed, करिष्यामि I will do.

40011350.author: Translation
40011350.content: 'I will pick up speed on the peaks of mount Mahendra filled with different kinds of trees and minerals.

40011351.author: पदार्थः
40011351.content: इतः from here, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतम् one hundred, प्लवतः for me as I leap, मम to me, निष्पेषं crushing force of, पादयोः of both feet, प्लवतां वरा: best among those who leap, धारयिष्यन्ति will withstand.

40011351.author: Translation
40011351.content: 'O great monkeys these mountain peaks can withstand the crushing force of my feet as I leap over a hundred yojanas.

40011352.author: पदार्थः
40011352.content: ततः then, मारुतप्रख्यः as eminent as the Windgod, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, अरिमर्दनः crusher of enemies, सः हरिः that monkey, नानाविधैः with several, वृक्षैः  trees, वृतम् covered, मृगसेवितशाद्वलम् grassy land inhabited by deer, लताकुसुमसम्बाधम् filled with creepers and fragrant flowers, नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम् ever with trees full of flowers and fruits, सिंहशार्दूलचरितं where lions and tigers move, मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम् inhabited by proud elephants, मत्तद्विजगणोद्घुष्टम् filled with flocks of intoxicated birds, सलिलोत्पीडसङ्कुलम् full of water falls, नगश्रेष्ठम् great mountain, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra, आरुरोह ascended.

40011352.author: Translation
40011352.content: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.

40011353.author: पदार्थः
40011353.content: ततः then, मारुतप्रख्यः as eminent as the Windgod, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, अरिमर्दनः crusher of enemies, सः हरिः that monkey, नानाविधैः with several, वृक्षैः  trees, वृतम् covered, मृगसेवितशाद्वलम् grassy land inhabited by deer, लताकुसुमसम्बाधम् filled with creepers and fragrant flowers, नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम् ever with trees full of flowers and fruits, सिंहशार्दूलचरितं where lions and tigers move, मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम् inhabited by proud elephants, मत्तद्विजगणोद्घुष्टम् filled with flocks of intoxicated birds, सलिलोत्पीडसङ्कुलम् full of water falls, नगश्रेष्ठम् great mountain, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra, आरुरोह ascended.

40011354.content: ततः then, मारुतप्रख्यः as eminent as the Windgod, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, अरिमर्दनः crusher of enemies, सः हरिः that monkey, नानाविधैः with several, वृक्षैः  trees, वृतम् covered, मृगसेवितशाद्वलम् grassy land inhabited by deer, लताकुसुमसम्बाधम् filled with creepers and fragrant flowers, नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम् ever with trees full of flowers and fruits, सिंहशार्दूलचरितं where lions and tigers move, मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम् inhabited by proud elephants, मत्तद्विजगणोद्घुष्टम् filled with flocks of intoxicated birds, सलिलोत्पीडसङ्कुलम् full of water falls, नगश्रेष्ठम् great mountain, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra, आरुरोह ascended.

40011354.content: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.

40011355.author: पदार्थः
40011355.content: महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः equal to Indra in valour, महाबलः mighty, हरिश्रेष्ठः best of the monkeys, महद्भि: great, शृङ्गैः with peaks, उच्छ्रितम् high, तम् him, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra, विचचार strode.

40011355.author: Translation
40011355.content: The mighty, preeminent monkey who was equal to Indra in valour took a leap from the high peaks of the tall mountain, Mahendra৷৷

40011356.author: पदार्थः
40011356.content: महात्मना by great self, तेन by him, बाहुभ्याम् with both his shoulders, पीडितः crushed, महाशैलः mighty mountain, सिंहाभिहतः struck by a lion, मत्तः proud, महान् great, द्विपः इव like an elephant, रराज looked.

40011356.author: Translation
40011356.content: Crushed by the feet of the great self, Hanuman, the huge mountain looked like a proud elephant struck by a lion.

40011357.author: पदार्थः
40011357.content: विप्रकीर्णशिलोच्चयः scattered rocks, वित्रस्तमृगमातङ्गः terrified deer and elephants, प्रकम्पितमहाद्रुमः violently shaken up trees, सलिलोत्पीडान् poured out gushing streams of water, मुमोच released.

40011357.author: Translation
40011357.content: The rocks of the mountain got scattered by the force. The deer and elephants were terrified. The trees were shaken up violently and streams of water gushed forth.

40011358.author: पदार्थः
40011358.content: तदा then, सः महागिरिः that great mountain, पानसंसर्गकर्कशैः by those whose behaviour was rough in a drunken state, नानागन्धर्वमिथुनैः by different groups of copulating gandharvas, उत्पतद्भि: by those flying, विहगैश्च by birds in the sky, विद्याधरगणैरपि hosts of vidyadharas, त्यज्यमानमहासानुः abandoned by the vast mountain slopes, सन्निलीनमहोरगः with serpents resting, चलशृङ्गशिलोद्घातः the rocks shaken up on mountain tops, अभूत् appeared.

40011358.author: Translation
40011358.content: Shaken by the rude shock, couples of intoxicated gandharvas left in a huff the vast slopes of the great mountain. Flocks of birds and groups of vidyadharas flew away. The serpents went into hiding. Rocks fell off the shaken mountain.

40011359.author: पदार्थः
40011359.content: तदा then, सः महागिरिः that great mountain, पानसंसर्गकर्कशैः by those whose behaviour was rough in a drunken state, नानागन्धर्वमिथुनैः by different groups of copulating gandharvas, उत्पतद्भि: by those flying, विहगैश्च by birds in the sky, विद्याधरगणैरपि hosts of vidyadharas, त्यज्यमानमहासानुः abandoned by the vast mountain slopes, सन्निलीनमहोरगः with serpents resting, चलशृङ्गशिलोद्घातः the rocks shaken up on mountain tops, अभूत् appeared.

40011359.author: Translation
40011359.content: Shaken by the rude shock, couples of intoxicated gandharvas left in a huff the vast slopes of the great mountain. Flocks of birds and groups of vidyadharas flew away. The serpents went into hiding. Rocks fell off the shaken mountain.

40011360.author: पदार्थः
40011360.content: तदा then, सः that, धरणीधरः holder of the earth, mountain, निश्वसद्भि: hissing out of the rocks, अर्धनि:सृतैः protruding half of their body, भुजगैः serpents, सपताकः इव like the flags, आभाति appeared.

40011360.author: Translation
40011360.content: The serpents with their bodies half protruded out of the rocks and hissing looked like flags planted on the mountain.

40011361.author: पदार्थः
40011361.content: त्राससम्भ्रान्तै: by those alarmed and agitated, ऋषिभिः by sages, त्यज्यमानः being abandoned, शिलोच्चयः the mountain, सार्थहीनः berefit of a caravan, महति in a great, कान्तारे in the forest, सीदन् while worrying, अध्वगः इव like the traveller.

40011361.author: Translation
40011361.content: The alarmed and agitated sages abandonned the mountain peaks.The mountain appeared like a lone traveller separated from the caravan in the great forest.

40011362.author: पदार्थः
40011362.content: वेगवान् speeds, वेगसमाहितात्मा fixing his attention on speed, परवीरहन्ता destroyer of enemy warriors, मनस्वी sensitive , महानुभावः noble, सः that, हरिप्रवीरः heroic monkey मनः in mind, समाधाय composed, मनसा mentally, लङ्काम् Lanka, जगाम reached.

40011362.author: Translation
40011362.content: Magnanimous, wise and heroic Hanuman, destroyer of enemy warriors, fixed his attention on speed, betook himself mentally to Lanka (ere he reached it physically). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामाणये वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyseventh sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
